scenes.name: Battlefield Clash
scenes.description: Initiative is rolled. Driving medieval battle music with sword clashes, war horns, crossbow fire, and a charging mob on the effects board.
scenes.author: PhyberApex

source.name: Medieval: Battle by RandomMind
source.note: CC0, no attribution required. Download battle.mp3.

source.name: Boss Battle Loop 1 (155 BPM) by kanaizo
source.note: CC0. 78-second loop with a detuned piano hook. Switch to this for the big bad.

source.name: Cold Howling Wind/Breeze (Loopable) by The_Isot_is_Back
source.note: CC0. 20-second loopable wind bed under the music.

source.name: sword against sword.wav by Fenodyrie
source.note: CC0. 79 seconds of real steel on steel. Trim a 2 to 3 second hit from it.

source.name: war horn.wav by adharca
source.note: CC0. 4-second horn blast to open combat.

source.name: Crossbow Firing and Hitting Target by Ali_6868
source.note: CC0. Short fire-and-hit, great for ranged attacks.

source.name: People screaming in agony when charging into battle by florianreichelt
source.note: CC0. 18-second crowd charge for reinforcements arriving.

source.name: Explosion.mp3 by florianreichelt
source.note: CC0. 5-second blast for fireballs and siege engines.

scenes.name: Cozy Tavern
scenes.description: A warm tavern with crackling fire, gentle chatter, and a bard playing in the corner. Perfect for social encounters and downtime.
scenes.author: PhyberApex

source.name: Medieval: King's Feast by RandomMind
source.note: CC0, no attribution required. Download Loop_Kings_Feast.wav. Any gentle bard or lute tavern music works.

source.name: Fireplace.wav by inchadney
source.note: CC0. 4-minute fireplace recording. Any fireplace or campfire loop works.

source.name: Ambience_Bar_No_Music.wav by Dokuta_Gerovv
source.note: CC0. 41-second low background crowd murmur.

source.name: Door, Church, Close, E.wav by InspectorJ
source.note: CC BY 4.0: credit 'InspectorJ (freesound.org)' if you redistribute a recording of your session. Any heavy wooden door works.

source.name: Mug slam and slosh.mp3 by Gingie
source.note: CC0. Mug or tankard hitting a wooden table.

scenes.name: Deep Forest Trail
scenes.description: Daylight travel through old woods: birdsong, a trickling creek, and gentle exploration music. Wolves and owls on call for when the sun goes down.
scenes.author: PhyberApex

source.name: Medieval: Exploration by RandomMind
source.note: CC0, no attribution required. Download Exploration.mp3. Any calm medieval travel track works.

source.name: Quiet Spring Woodland Ambience by ecfike
source.note: CC0. Seamless 1-minute forest loop. Alternative: Spring Birds & Woodpeckers (Loop) by Resaural, https://freesound.org/people/Resaural/sounds/634511/ (CC0, 7 min).

source.name: Creek 06 (loop) by VKProduktion
source.note: CC0. 36-second loopable creek. Any small stream loop works.

source.name: Rolling Wind - looping by ERR0
source.note: CC0. 30-second seamless wind loop. Enable for high ground or an approaching storm.

source.name: Wolf howl by NaturesTemper
source.note: CC0. 8-second single howl. Good for distant danger.

source.name: Owl Hoot by Breviceps
source.note: CC0. 4-second hoot for night-time travel.

source.name: Crossbow Firing and Hitting Target by Ali_6868
source.note: CC0. For a sudden ambush from the treeline.

scenes.name: Dungeon Crawl
scenes.description: Torchlit corridors deep underground: a low dungeon drone, dripping water, and the rattle of chains. Stone doors and distant rumbles ready as effects.
scenes.author: PhyberApex

source.name: Dungeon Ambience by yd
source.note: CC0. Download dungeon002.ogg. Alternative: Dark Theme by JaggedStone, https://opengameart.org/content/dark-theme (CC0).

source.name: Loopable Dungeon Ambience by JaggedStone
source.note: CC0. Download dungeon_ambient_1.ogg. Low wind with water drips, loops cleanly.

source.name: Water Dripping in Cave.wav by Sclolex
source.note: CC0. 90 seconds of processed cave drips.

source.name: A_Dungeon_Ambience_Loop.wav by Grubzyy
source.note: CC0. 29-second loop of distant ominous rumbles. Enable when the party nears something big.

source.name: Heavy stone door opens 2 by PostProdDog
source.note: CC0. 14-second slab dragging open. Works for sarcophagus lids too.

source.name: Chain Rattling by Kp69606
source.note: CC0. 13 seconds of chains dragging on the ground. Shorter alternative: Chains.wav by cribbler, https://freesound.org/people/cribbler/sounds/370877/ (CC0, 6 s).

source.name: Explosion.mp3 by florianreichelt
source.note: CC0. 5-second blast for collapsing tunnels or a triggered trap.

scenes.name: Haunted Crypt
scenes.description: Something is awake beneath the chapel. Dungeon-synth dread, ghostly whispers, tolling funeral bells, and a scream for the moment the lid slides off.
scenes.author: PhyberApex

source.name: Eternal Sleep by Kaiser (uploaded by The Oracle)
source.note: CC0. Dark ambient / dungeon synth FLAC. Alternative: Horror Atmosphere by Juhani Junkala, https://opengameart.org/content/horror-atmosphere (CC0, loop-ready).

source.name: HorrorCaveAmbience.mp3 by shelbyshark
source.note: CC0. 38-second loopable spooky ambience.

source.name: Ghost Whispers by Litruv
source.note: CC0. 23 seconds of reversed whispering. Hibiki's random interval makes it drift in and out.

source.name: Dark Cavern Ambient by Paul Wortmann
source.note: CC0. Download dark_cavern_ambient_002.ogg, the continuous loop version.

source.name: funeral bell-cloche funèbre.wav by aoristos
source.note: CC0. 29 seconds of real church bells from a medieval chapel in France.

source.name: Demonic Woman Scream.wav by nick121087
source.note: CC0. 4-second processed scream. Use sparingly.

source.name: Heavy stone door opens 2 by PostProdDog
source.note: CC0. 14-second stone slab dragging open.

source.name: Chains.wav by cribbler
source.note: CC0. 6-second chain shake.

scenes.name: High Seas Voyage
scenes.description: Aboard a creaking wooden ship under open sky. Waves, gulls, and a port-town theme, with cannon fire and the ship's bell ready for trouble on the horizon.
scenes.author: PhyberApex

source.name: Merchants and Sea Salt by NBJDLukasAbsolute
source.note: CC0. Port-town theme for calm sailing and harbour scenes.

source.name: Pirates libertaires by Komiku (Loyalty Freak Music)
source.note: CC0. Upbeat pirate adventure track for chases and boarding actions.

source.name: LargeWoodenShip.mp3 by PimFeijen
source.note: CC0. 10 minutes of creaking hull and waves. Carries the whole scene on its own.

source.name: Calm ocean waves by SamsterBirdies
source.note: CC0. 3-minute looping shoreline. Enable when anchored or on the beach.

source.name: sea gulls.wav by Snapper4298
source.note: CC0. 7-second gull calls. Let the random interval scatter them.

source.name: Cannon Shot by qubodup
source.note: CC0. 12-second real cannon with echo.

source.name: Ship Bell Two Chimes by Sojan
source.note: CC0. 3-second double chime for 'land ho' or all hands on deck.

source.name: Heavy Thunder Strike - no Rain - QUADRO.wav by BlueDelta
source.note: CC0. For the storm rolling in. Trim the first 10 seconds.

scenes.name: Market Day
scenes.description: A bustling town square on market day: vendor chatter, a blacksmith at work, coin changing hands, and a cheerful minstrel tune. Built for shopping and rumour gathering.
scenes.author: PhyberApex

source.name: Medieval: Market Day by RandomMind
source.note: CC0, no attribution required. Download Loop_Market_Day.mp3 for the seamless version.

source.name: Street-Market-Gap-France.wav by Astounded
source.note: CC0. 15 minutes of a real French street market with vendor chatter. The uploader asks to be contacted for commercial use, which does not apply to running your own game.

source.name: Hammer and anvil by Duasun
source.note: CC0. 26 seconds of anvil strikes. The random interval makes it feel like a smithy across the square.

source.name: Ambience_Bar_No_Music.wav by Dokuta_Gerovv
source.note: CC0. 41-second indoor crowd murmur for stepping into a shop or tavern.

source.name: Coins Being Dropped-Assorted by TheWoodlandNomad
source.note: CC0. 24 seconds of assorted coin drops. Trim a short clip for a purchase.

source.name: funeral bell-cloche funèbre.wav by aoristos
source.note: CC0. Real medieval church bells. Trim a few tolls to mark the hour.

source.name: Door, Church, Close, E.wav by InspectorJ
source.note: CC BY 4.0: credit 'InspectorJ (freesound.org)' if you redistribute a recording of your session. Any wooden door works.

scenes.name: Stormy Night at the Inn
scenes.description: Rain against the shutters, a fire in the hearth, and thunder rolling over the hills. A rest scene for long nights and quiet roleplay.
scenes.author: PhyberApex

source.name: Medieval: King's Feast by RandomMind
source.note: CC0, no attribution required. Download Loop_Kings_Feast.wav. Keep it low under the rain.

source.name: Ambiance_Atmosphere_Interior_Wood_Rain_Thunders_Fire_Loop_Stereo.ogg by Nox_Sound
source.note: CC0. 56-second indoor loop that already mixes rain, thunder and a fireplace. This one track carries the whole scene.

source.name: Rain from Indoors - Perfect loop by samesamesame
source.note: CC0. 48-second seamless indoor rain loop. Enable instead of the combined track for rain without fire.

source.name: Fireplace.wav by inchadney
source.note: CC0. 4-minute fireplace recording, pairs with the plain rain loop.

source.name: Heavy Thunder Strike - no Rain - QUADRO.wav by BlueDelta
source.note: CC0. Big close strike with a long tail. Trim the first 10 seconds for a punchy hit.

source.name: rain_thunder_loop.flac by Nimlos
source.note: CC0. 36-second rain with a single distant rumble. Also works as a third ambience layer.

source.name: Door, Church, Close, E.wav by InspectorJ
source.note: CC BY 4.0: credit 'InspectorJ (freesound.org)' if you redistribute a recording of your session. Any heavy wooden door works.
